title: Russian Bread Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring layers of bread and Russian-style ingredients. This casserole is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the sliced Russian sausage over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
In a separate skillet, sauté the chopped onion until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the bread cubes, cooked sausage, sautéed onion, shredded cheese, beef broth, sour cream, dried parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
